items.title: 3 Cash Management Software Stocks Worth Watching As Liquidity Moves Back Into Focus
items.summary: Markets are wrestling with high living costs, fraught geopolitics and an AI boom that already looks stretched, all while federal debt approaches US$40b and policy room stays tight. Cash is no longer a boring footnote. It is a potential safety net and a weapon. This article examines three corporate treasury and cash-optimization software stocks exposed to these cross-currents and outlines why their tools, and their risks, may be relevant for portfolio decisions.
